trades.name: Short downtrend below Friday's low
trades.quote: Riding short a downtrend below Friday’s low ESPECIALLY if ES has also broken down is an A+ setup. I generally don’t care for breakdown shorts but with cooperation from ES this has potential for violence and I’m here for that.

trades.name: LAAF of 25369-25388 on rejection of Friday's B-period singles
trades.quote: A strong rejection in Friday’s B-period singles triggering a LAAF of 369-388 is a dream setup. I would monitor 315 and the weekly 282-292 for continuation but expect 237 to print and have a very good chance of riding runners to and through Friday’s low. This is the best setup out there right now. It doesn’t mean that it will setup nor does it mean that it will reach all targets, but it has very good reason to do both. This is probably the best A+ setup I’ve seen in some time.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.tag: A+ (if ES in LBAF) / B+/A- (if ES holding Friday's low)
trades.quote: A LBAF of Friday’s low (especially once 150 is firmly reclaimed) is also a very decent setup if ES has done the same or is otherwise strong. It is hard for me to trust buyers here at all (has been quite a while since saying that) but because of all of the above factors (lack of volume build thus far, conflict with ES, potential range) I have to begrudgingly rate this an A+ if ES is in the midst of a LBAF as well and a B+/A- if ES is holding Friday’s low. Even just to Friday’s VPOC on NQ (237ish) would be around 100 handles so that is going to have my attention. This would have potential for 369-388 and an outside chance of 482-502 so even though reaching 502 would be rather low probability there is enough range for a green trade to be ensured and see what runners can do.

trades.name: Session downtrend below 25369-25388
trades.quote: Aside from that I will happily be short in any session downtrend on NQ below 369-388.

trades.name: Firm rejection of single prints (LAAF of 6866.5-6869)
trades.quote: If we see a firm rejection of the single prints on ES I am more likely to look and see where NQ is at and consider shorting it instead, but it is a valid trade on ES with the above targets.
